reading: Anthropic has identified and disrupted attempts to use its AI model for "malicious activity" linked to biological weapons.
The company's threat intelligence report includes revelations about these dangerous activities.
This follows warnings from a former top researcher about the potential risks of AI to humanity.
Claude, Anthropic's AI model, was also used by actors linked to a Russia-based cyber espionage campaign.
Other cases of concern ranged from fake dating apps to surveillance built to identify dissidents.
Anthropic also blocked scientists who used its AI in ways that could support biological weapons development.
Biological misuse is considered "one of the most serious risks of frontier AI model" because it "could have catastrophic consequences" without proper safeguards.
The company noted that the same information used for biological weapons can also develop vaccines or disease cures.
Anthropic is incorporating these findings into its processes to better prevent and disrupt similar activities in the future.

vocabulary.definition: recognized or found something that exists.
interrupted something or caused it to stop working normally.
intending or intended to cause harm or trouble.
surprising or important facts that are revealed.
possible in the future, but not yet real.
people who disagree strongly with official policies, especially in a country with strict control.
measures taken to protect something or someone from harm or danger.
causing sudden, great damage or suffering.
including something as part of a larger whole.

entries.ja: 存在するものを見つけたり、認識したりした。
entries.zh-Hans: 识别或发现已经存在的事物。
entries.es: Reconocer o encontrar algo que existe.
entries.pt-BR: Reconhecer ou encontrar algo que existe.

entries.ja: 何かを中断させたり、正常に機能しなくさせたりした。
entries.ko: 어떤 것을 중단시키거나 정상적으로 작동하지 못하게 한.
entries.zh-Hans: 中断某事，或使其停止正常运作。
entries.es: Interrumpir algo o hacer que deje de funcionar normalmente.
entries.pt-BR: Interromper algo ou fazer com que pare de funcionar normalmente.

entries.ja: 害や問題を引き起こす意図がある、またはその意図で作られた。
entries.ko: 해를 끼치거나 문제를 일으키려는 의도를 가진, 또는 그러한 의도로 만들어진.
entries.zh-Hans: 意图或旨在造成伤害或麻烦的。
entries.es: Con la intención de causar daño o problemas, o creado con esa intención.
entries.pt-BR: Que tem a intenção ou é feito para causar dano ou problema.

entries.ja: 明らかにされた驚くべき、または重要な事実。
entries.zh-Hans: 被揭示的令人惊讶或重要的事实。
entries.es: Hechos sorprendentes o importantes que se revelan.
entries.pt-BR: Fatos surpreendentes ou importantes que são revelados.

entries.ja: 将来的に可能であるが、まだ現実ではない。
entries.ko: 미래에 가능성이 있지만 아직 현실이 아닌.
entries.zh-Hans: 将来可能发生，但尚未成为现实的。
entries.es: Posible en el futuro, pero aún no real.
entries.pt-BR: Possível no futuro, mas ainda não real.

entries.ja: 特に厳しく統制された国において、公式な政策に強く反対する人々。
entries.ko: 특히 엄격하게 통제되는 국가에서, 공식적인 정책에 강력히 반대하는 사람들.
entries.zh-Hans: 强烈反对官方政策的人，尤其是在受到严格管控的国家。
entries.es: Personas que están fuertemente en desacuerdo con las políticas oficiales, especialmente en un país con control estricto.
entries.pt-BR: Pessoas que discordam fortemente de políticas oficiais, especialmente em um país com controle rígido.

entries.ja: 何かや誰かを危害や危険から守るために取られる措置。
entries.ko: 무언가나 누군가를 해나 위험으로부터 보호하기 위해 취하는 조치.
entries.zh-Hans: 为保护某物或某人免受伤害或危险而采取的措施。
entries.es: Medidas tomadas para proteger algo o a alguien de daños o peligros.
entries.pt-BR: Medidas tomadas para proteger algo ou alguém de danos ou perigos.

entries.ja: 突然に大きな損害や苦痛を引き起こす。
entries.zh-Hans: 造成突然的巨大损害或痛苦的。
entries.es: Que causa daños o sufrimientos grandes y repentinos.
entries.pt-BR: Que causa danos ou sofrimentos grandes e repentinos.

entries.ja: 何かをより大きな全体の一部として含めること。
entries.ko: 무언가를 더 큰 전체의 일부로 포함시키는 것.
entries.zh-Hans: 将某物作为更大整体的一部分包含在内。
entries.es: Incluir algo como parte de un todo más grande.
entries.pt-BR: Incluir algo como parte de um todo maior.
